chunks: Jibrāʾīl came to Yūsuf عليه السلام while he was in the prison and said: O Yūsuf, say after every obligatory prayer: O Allah, make for me from my affair relief and a way out, and provide for me from where I expect and from where I do not expect.

key_terms.السِّجْنِ: the prison, the place of Yūsuf's confinement
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibrāʾīl, the angel who brought divine instruction
key_terms.مَخْرَجًا: a way out or escape from difficulty
key_terms.يُوسُفُ: Yūsuf عليه السلام, the prophet addressed in the narration

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited after every obligatory prayer for relief and sustenance?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that Jibrāʾīl instructed Yūsuf عليه السلام, while in prison, to recite a du'a after every obligatory prayer. It emphasizes seeking relief, deliverance, and sustenance from Allah through supplication in the ta'qīb of salat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.950 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Archangel Jibril (as) came to Yusuf (as) while he was in prison and said:
'O’ Yusuf, say after every obligatory prayer:
‘O’ Allah (swt), make for me a relief and an escape from my affairs, and grant me sustenance from where I expect and from where I do not expect”.
